title: Let the Name clear the fog
summary: The Guru plants Naam so doubt gives way to light and direction. Let planted Naam become the light for the next step.
takeaway: Let planted Naam become the light for the next step.
lifeApplication: Before chasing another explanation, stay with the Name the Guru has planted until the path brightens.
